newsitem.title: CANADA: Manitoba Telco revs to pay C$150 mln health debt.
newsitem.headline: Manitoba Telco revs to pay C$150 mln health debt.

text.p: Manitoba's provincial government on Friday said it would use C$150 million in proceeds from December's public share offering of former government owned Manitoba Telecom Services to pay down part of its hospital and personal home care debt.

"By taking C$150 million from the proceeds and using them on a one-time basis to pay down existing hospital and personal care home debt, we aree able to reduce the annual cost of servicing the debt," Manitoba Health Minister Darren Praznik said in a statement.
Manitoba's health care debt currently is C$750 million.
